findings.finding_summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 26 randomized controlled trials (1,721 participants) reported significantly improved skin hydration with hydrolyzed collagen supplementation versus placebo.
findings.limitations: many included trials are manufacturer-sponsored and use proprietary peptide blends

findings.finding_summary: The same meta-analysis reported significantly improved skin elasticity with hydrolyzed collagen versus placebo.
findings.limitations: many included trials are manufacturer-sponsored and use proprietary peptide blends

findings.finding_summary: In this randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial, oral collagen peptides increased water content in the stratum corneum and epidermis, attributed to increased natural moisturizing factor.
findings.limitations: skin elasticity and skin thickness were reported as unchanged in the same trial

findings.endpoint: skin hydration and periorbital wrinkle depth (oral, 120 mg/day)
findings.finding_summary: In this randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 150 healthy adults, 120 mg/day oral sodium hyaluronate was reported to improve skin hydration and elasticity and reduce transepidermal water loss and periorbital wrinkle depth versus placebo.
findings.limitations: the 60 mg/day arm showed weaker effects; endpoint direction here summarizes the hydration/elasticity improvement

findings.finding_summary: In this 12-week double-blinded placebo-controlled study of 40 adults, daily oral hyaluronan was associated with improved wrinkle assessment, stratum corneum water content, transepidermal water loss, and elasticity versus placebo.
In this multicenter vehicle-controlled trial, 79% of participants using topical 0.05% tretinoin for 24 weeks showed overall improvement in photodamaged skin versus 48% with vehicle.
findings.limitations: topical prescription use; skin irritation is the characteristic adverse effect of tretinoin therapy

findings.finding_summary: In this double-blind vehicle-controlled comparison, 0.1% and 0.025% tretinoin creams produced statistically similar overall photoaging improvement, while the higher concentration caused more irritation.
findings.limitations: the between-concentration comparison is the endpoint here; both concentrations improved photoaging versus vehicle

findings.finding_summary: This review reported limited evidence for biotin's efficacy on hair growth in healthy individuals, with the highest-quality double-blind placebo-controlled trial finding no difference between biotin and placebo; reported benefits concentrate in deficiency-related hair loss.
findings.limitations: evidence for benefit exists mainly in biotin-deficiency states, which are rare in well-nourished adults

findings.finding_summary: This review of nail-health literature reported that brittle nail syndrome appears to abate with 2.5 mg/day biotin supplementation.
findings.limitations: applies to brittle-nail conditions specifically, not general nail health; older uncontrolled studies underlie the claim

findings.endpoint: investigator global assessment in papulopustular rosacea
findings.finding_summary: This network meta-analysis of 19 randomized controlled trials (8,208 participants) reported azelaic acid 20% with the largest odds of investigator-assessed improvement among compared topical and oral agents (odds ratio 8.54, 95% CI 2.48 to 29.45).
findings.limitations: network meta-analysis (indirect comparisons contribute); azelaic acid 15% showed significantly higher adverse-event odds than comparators

findings.endpoint: inflammatory lesion count in papulopustular rosacea (topical 20%)
findings.finding_summary: In this double-blind vehicle-controlled trial, azelaic acid 20% cream reduced total inflammatory lesions by a reported 73.4% versus 50.6% with vehicle, with greater erythema reduction as well.

findings.endpoint: fine wrinkling in naturally aged skin (topical 0.4%)
findings.finding_summary: In this randomized double-blind vehicle-controlled trial of 36 elderly participants, topical 0.4% retinol lotion applied up to three times weekly significantly improved fine-wrinkling scores versus vehicle after 24 weeks.
findings.limitations: n=36; very elderly cohort; cosmetic topical use
